subject: Offer packet for Danielle Kaplan — equity / visa / start options
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft offer for Danielle Kaplan — please review

Team,

Attached is the first pass at an offer for Danielle (SWE II candidate). Key items I pulled from the loop with recruiting and the hiring manager: base comp in band 5, equity target ~0.6% (4yr), flexible start (early June to mid-July), potential visa sponsorship (H-1B transfer) and relocation assistance.

Asks:
- Can you confirm the comp band and suggested base? I penciled $155,000.
- Is 0.6% equity in line with band 5 for a non-manager SWE?
- Should we include a signing bonus instead of bumping base?
- Redlines on the standard conditional start clause and visa sponsorship language (I want to avoid open-ended promises).

I'm copying Laura for total comp approval and Marissa for payroll/relocation ops. If we can get a finalized doc by EOD Friday I'll send to the candidate for signature next week.

Attachment: offer-draft-DanielleKaplan_v1.docx

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Recruiting Partner (clarifying role)
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft offer for Danielle Kaplan — please review

Sergio —

Quick notes after reviewing the draft:
- Comp band: confirm Band 5, base salary recommendation $150,000–$160,000. Recommend $157,500 as midpoint offer to be competitive.
- Equity: 0.6% is acceptable but given strong candidate feedback I'd push to 0.75% for sign leverage OR offer a $10k signing bonus payable in first payroll. Either is fine; suggest leaning to signing bonus to keep equity consistent across band.
- Vesting/clawback: keep standard 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff and the 12-month clawback only for commissionable roles — remove any ambiguous clawback language.
- Visa sponsorship: include an explicit clause: "Offer contingent on the candidate providing documentation necessary for transfer/validation; Redwood will reimburse up to $3,000 in immigration legal fees upon submission of receipts." Do not promise H-1B approval timelines.
- Start date: propose two options in the offer: 1) target start 2026-06-15 or 2) flexible up to 2026-07-15 if visa/notice period requires. State that start is subject to background check and I-9 completion.
- Relocation: flat relocation stipend $7,500 taxable. Coordinate with Marissa for payroll mechanics and gross-up if needed.

I made tracked changes in the attached file.

Attachment: neha_redlines_v1.docx

I'll approve sending to candidate once you confirm whether we do 0.75% equity vs $10k sign-on.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of Total Rewards
Redwood Inference
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Kaplan <danielle.kaplan@gmail.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final offer from Redwood Inference — Danielle Kaplan

Danielle —

It was great speaking with you — we're excited about the possibility of you joining Redwood. Please find the formal offer attached. High-level summary of the offer (please review the attached PDF for full legal language):
- Role: Software Engineer II
- Base salary: $157,500 annually
- Equity: 0.60% RSU grant, 4-year vesting with 1-year cliff
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (paid in first payroll, subject to repayment if employment ends within 12 months)
- Relocation stipend: $7,500
- Start date: target 2026-06-15; if visa or notice period requires we can extend to 2026-07-15 — confirm preference in reply
- Contingencies: standard background check and eligibility to work in the U.S. Redwood will assist with immigration transfer and reimburse up to $3,000 in immigration legal fees upon submission of receipts.

Please review and let me know any questions. If you'd like an earlier start we can explore it but we'll need to confirm background check timing with ops. If the terms look good, reply here to confirm and I'll send a DocuSign link (or you can sign the attached PDF and return). We ask for confirmation by end of day 2026-05-28 to hold the package.

Attachment: Redwood_Offer_DanielleKaplan_20260522.pdf

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Danielle Kaplan <danielle.kaplan@gmail.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final offer from Redwood Inference — Danielle Kaplan

Thanks so much — and thanks everyone for moving quickly. A few quick questions before I confirm: 

1) Equity vs signing bonus: I appreciate the $10k signing bonus. Given market comps and the seniority of the role, would Redwood consider 0.75% equity instead of the 0.60% (with the $10k bonus removed)? Equity is a stronger long-term motivator for me.

2) Start date: I can do 2026-06-15 if background check completes quickly. I am also mid-H-1B transfer — my counsel estimates the transfer window could take 6–8 weeks. Can Redwood start the I-9 and background check remotely so we can get those steps underway prior to travel?

3) Relocation: thank you for the stipend. Would Redwood consider covering initial temporary housing (2 weeks) or providing a lump sum gross-up to help with taxes? If not, I can work with the stipend.

4) Repayment clause on signing bonus: can we shorten the repayment period to 6 months prorated instead of 12 months?

I quoted the relevant paragraphs below for context. Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call if that's easier. Looking forward to next steps.
